p=os.fork()

for depth in range(3):

 if p:break
os.setsid() if os.getpid()!=1 else None
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
pathlib.Path('/validation/ready.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':os.getpid(),'cgroup':pathlib.Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text()}))
time.sleep(30)
